headline: Abhishek Singhania files SEBI Takeover Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) for Jaykay Enterprises
sum: Abhishek Singhania has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI's Takeover Regulations with the NSE. The filing indicates a material shareholding acquisition in Jaykay Enterprises Limited, though the exact shareholding percentage and acquisition value are not disclosed in the headline announcement.
detail: The disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 was submitted to NSE by the acquirer. Regulation 31(4) mandates that any person acquiring shares in a listed company must disclose material changes in shareholding to the stock exchange. The specific shareholding percentage, acquisition mechanism (open market, negotiated deal, or creeping acquisition), and consideration remain to be detailed in the full disclosure document available on the NSE archives.
